title: Bound on advanced movement counts
statement: Let $l$ be a natural number, let $d$ assign a sign in $\{-1,0,1\}$ to each of $l$ coordinates, and let $n$ assign a natural-number count to each of the $2l$ doubled coordinates. If every count is at most $t$, then after increasing each count selected by the sign vector by one, every resulting count is at most $t+1$.
replaced: If every movement count is at most $t$, then after advancing along any displacement vector every count is at most $t + 1$.
